name: details-target-set-consistency
body:
The durable spec's `details` edge kind must have ONE canonical target set, agreed by the write surface and the graph projection, so an edge the write surface accepts is always visible in the graph and an edge the projection excludes is always refused at write time — never accepted and then silently dropped.

Canonical set: a `details` edge's target may be any authored node EXCEPT a `Note` (any layer), or a code FQN (module/file/struct/function). `Note`→`Note` `details` is refused. `Note` remains REVIEWABLE — `Reviews` (`Feedback`→`Note`) is a distinct edge kind and is explicitly unchanged (non-goal).

Today the write surface and the projection disagree: the `details` arm of `rust.apg.layers.validate.validate_edge` requires only a `note` SOURCE and exempts the target, so it accepts a `Note` target; the projection's `Details` target list (`rust.apg.load.tables.spec_rel_pairs`) deliberately omits `Note`, so the accepted pair is dropped with no error and is invisible to `apg_query`. That is data loss without a diagnostic.

Acceptance criteria:
- `apg edge add details <note-fqn> <other-note-fqn>` is REFUSED with an actionable error naming the edge kind (`details`), the source, and the target — no longer accepted and then dropped.
- A `details` edge whose target is any other authored node (stakeholder/user/requirement/group/entity/value/service/system/container/component/person/constraint, in any layer) or a code FQN is still accepted, and both endpoint files are still written.
- The projection side is UNCHANGED: `rust.apg.load.tables.spec_rel_pairs` keeps `Note` out of the `Details` target list, its deliberate-exclusion comment stays, and no schema/DB change is made.
- `Reviews` (`Feedback`→`Note`) is unchanged — `Note` remains reviewable.
- The `unit`-tier test in `src/layers/tests.rs` that today asserts `details` accepts any target flips to assert the `Note`-target refusal while continuing to accept every other authored node and code FQN; it stays in the `unit` submodule per `global.constraint.test-tier-boundaries`.
- The load unit test `rust.apg.load.tests.unit.reviews_pairs_admit_note_but_details_still_excludes_it` and the e2e test `rust.artifacts_e2e.e2e.illegal_details_pair_is_projected_away_not_a_binder_error` stay green, untouched.

Scope: the durable `apg edge add` write surface only. The transient plan-JSONL path that also projects an undeclared pair away never calls `validate_edge` and is out of scope; its e2e stays green as-is.
